budget.hard_deadline: allocation request time + min(24.7/3, 11.862) h - 300 s = +8.233 h - 5 min (conservative 3 CU/h)
budget.own_rate_check: After allocation, own rate = account rate - 1.15 if trust still listed; must be 0 < rate <= 3 or the session is stopped.
budget.accounting: Own allocated time (request to verified stop) x measured own rate; account balance deltas not used because trust spend is mixed in.

watchdog.mechanism: Windows Task Scheduler one-shot task 'rtdetr1123-cl-watchdog', created BEFORE the allocation request, runs claude_watchdog.cmd at the hard deadline: 'colab stop -s <own session>' then 'colab sessions' logged to watchdog.log. Independent of any LLM process.
watchdog.limit: Requires this PC to be on and the user logged in at the deadline. It cannot release an unnamed assignment from a stalled 'colab new'; a stalled request is checked manually via 'colab sessions'.

hardware: L4 required. If L4 is not granted: no silent switch. T4 only after a separate committed amendment backed by a <=1 CU throughput pilot showing the baseline fits; A100 forbidden.
failure_limits: At most 2 more allocation attempts; at most 2 failures per stage; no optimisation loops. After 2 allocation failures: stop and report the blocker.
